truth.description: App 5.2.0 payment SDK times out at the gateway; fixed by 5.2.1
New address validator rejects German and UK postcodes on web checkout
Search service degradation: web search page load x6
Add-to-cart API returns 500 for Android 13 on app 5.1.x

recovery.note: observed < true because cross-device returns are only linkable when identity is stitched with consent

sample_checks.check: product active at event time (launched <= ts < discontinued)
ticket opened <= first_response <= escalated <= resolved <= closed
ticket opened_at = first contact session start
ticket opened after origin session start
cart_item.quantity = sum(add_to_cart.quantity) within the line's lifetime
order lines = active cart items (product, qty)
converted carts have exactly one order
email/push traffic only for persons with marketing consent (vs. truth person)
web/app sessions of a device separated by > 30 min
duplicate client_event_id rows are all labelled (and vice versa)
orders with >1 purchase event are all labelled (and vice versa)
sessions with ingestion/occurrence inversion (excl. labelled duplicates) are all labelled (and vice versa)
every anomaly references an existing entity
session_labels cover every session exactly once
